learning_objective: 🎯 We will take a magical trip to a fair and learn how to easily add and subtract numbers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If you buy 2 red balloons and 3 blue balloons at the fun fair, you just add them! 2 and 3 makes 5 balloons in total.
If you have 5 sweet candies and you eat 2 of them, you subtract! Now you only have 3 candies left in your pocket.
Math helps us buy game tickets and count the rings we throw at the fair. It makes playing games even more fun!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Shopkeeper Game
fun_activity.instructions: Set up a small toy shop at home. Give price tags to your toys and practice adding numbers when your parents pretend to buy them!

quick_recap: ⭐ Adding means bringing things together to make a bigger number.
⭐ Subtracting means taking things away to make a smaller number.
⭐ We use addition and subtraction every day when we buy things.
